ada: quick sync  i'm finishing the docs changelog entry for the micro-update. main points: fallback routing example, streaming-embeddings large-payload quirk, one broken redirect, and a tiny rust sdk snippet typo fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210

tom: reading. prefer bullets in the changelog box, 2-3 terse lines. link the migration guide for full steps.

nina: i pushed a rust snippet fix in examples/rust: iterator method name was wrong (`next_msg` -> `next_message`). small docs commit.

ryan: added a short Python fallback example in a whatsnew-friendly size. sharing here for review:
```python
# minimal fallback routing example
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate(
    model="redwood-kitefish-v1",
    fallbacks=["redwood-kitefish-v1-quant", "gpt-compatible-fallback"],
)
print(resp.text)
```

sasha: looks good. please add a parenthetical: (quantized fallback may use a different tokenizer; verify prompt & stop tokens).

ada: (typo) ada: noted. will add the parenthetical and a link to the quantization guide.

nina: found one 404 under /docs/dedicated/autoscale. opened PR #4211 to add a redirect to /docs/dedicated/scaling.

tom: for changelog bullets suggest: 1) Added fallback routing example + snippet, 2) Known issue: streaming embeddings may truncate on payloads >4MB (link to workaround), 3) Docs: rust SDK iterator typo fixed. keep each bullet technical.

sasha: editorial nit  avoid "improved" or "better" in whatsnew. use precise verbs like "added", "fixed", "documented".

docs-bot: reminder: docs staging deploy scheduled for tomorrow 09:30 UTC after signoff.

ryan: LGTM from me after parenthetical and redirect note are added. i will run the site build locally and smoke-test the examples.

nina: LGTM  rust example renders. redirect PR ready.

tom: LGTM. small inline wording suggestion on the PR.

ada: thanks all  i'll update the PR now, request formal LGTM by 07:30 UTC, and merge once green. i'll ping when staging is up. :rocket:
